claim_boundary.claim: paired read-only comparison of current SL close against separately defined hedge/reverse-stop alternatives

cohort.source: execution_ledger ORDER_FILLED joined to the frozen ORDER_ACCEPTED TP/SL and a resolved TRADE_CLOSED STOP_LOSS_ORDER
cohort.outcome_conditioning_note: This is the SL-trigger diagnostic cohort. It is not an entry-strategy profitability cohort.
cohort.anchor_rule: maximum fill_at among every resolved ledger trade with frozen accepted TP and SL, without filtering on outcome
cohort.split_rule: chronological first 60 percent TRAIN and final 40 percent VALIDATION; events in the 3600-second boundary embargo are excluded
cohort.holdout: sealed forward-only events strictly after anchor_utc; may be opened once only after every preregistered TRAIN and VALIDATION gate passes

arms.definition: original position closes at the frozen SL; actual ledger fill is the economic control
close original at SL and open opposite 0.25 units at the same SL trigger; fixed 3600-second unwind
close original at SL and open opposite 0.35 units at the same SL trigger; fixed 3600-second unwind
retain original and open equal opposite units at initial entry; dual unwind at the control close
arms.structural_null: price P/L is locked; before non-spread cost the maximum is zero only under zero spread

arms.definition: retain original and open equal opposite units at the SL trigger; fixed 3600-second dual unwind
arms.structural_null: loss is locked at the trigger and cannot recover while both equal legs remain; later changes are costs only

data_contract.price_truth: OANDA S5 bid/ask complete candles or approved historical tick only
data_contract.missing_s5: record as missing; endpoint economics may be diagnostic only when executable endpoint exists, but any path gap makes DD/fill-order proof incomplete and blocks adoption
data_contract.first_touch: must be an unambiguous executable-side SL touch; same-candle TP and SL blocks the event
data_contract.entry_and_unwind: must bind to observed executable bid/ask ranges; no best-price selection
data_contract.same_s5_fill_order: conservative adverse ordering; unresolved ordering blocks adoption

cost_contract.spread: intrinsic executable bid/ask on every leg
cost_contract.fee_reason: current OANDA FX account cost surface is spread-based; any nonzero broker fee discovered later is additive and cannot improve an arm
cost_contract.slippage: event-specific observed adverse control SL slippage is charged per unit to each counterfactual entry/unwind leg; zero or favorable observed slippage is floored at zero
cost_contract.financing: ledger financing is included in control; counterfactual rollover financing must be known or bounded non-favorably, otherwise adoption is blocked
cost_contract.opportunity_cost: report peak incremental gross margin and margin-hours; no unverified positive benefit is credited
cost_contract.margin_stress: report both broker longest-leg margin and double-gross-leg margin

statistics.unit: trade-level paired net JPY delta against CONTROL_CURRENT_SL
statistics.small_sample_rule: metrics are diagnostic and LCB cannot support adoption below 30 events in either split

risk_proxies.initial_equity_proxy_jpy: window peak CONTROL_CURRENT_SL broker margin divided by the existing 45 percent same-pair margin concentration cap
risk_proxies.drawdown_limit_jpy: 2 percent of initial_equity_proxy_jpy, matching the RiskPolicy daily_risk_pct default
risk_proxies.margin_closeout: equity at or below 50 percent of the arm peak broker margin
risk_proxies.gross_margin_utilization: peak_double_gross_margin_jpy divided by initial_equity_proxy_jpy; must be at most 92 percent
risk_proxies.interpretation: deterministic stress proxies only; no ruin probability is estimated

required_in_every_validation_window: no unresolved fill order or partial-fill failure
no S5/tick path gap for DD
no ruin or margin-closeout proxy breach
acceptance.decision: ACCEPT only if all arms claimed for adoption pass all applicable gates; otherwise REJECT the failing arm without hiding positive subwindows

refinement.single_changed_variable: fixed unwind seconds changes from 3600 to 1800

independent_recalculation: a separate standard-library calculator must recompute aggregate net, PF, expectancy, DD and paired CI from the sealed per-event rows before final decision
